title: geranium parviflorum var. humile
intro: Geranium parviflorum var. humile, commonly known as Dwarf Mountain Geranium, is a plant species that belongs to the family Geraniaceae. It is a perennial herb with various health benefits, including its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Mountain Geranium include its ability to promote wound healing, reduce stress and anxiety, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
